notes: New data identity: starts from random weights, rather than loading the old 1M-sample checkpoint.
Validation documents/tensors match the baseline, but evaluation uses all 300 windows instead of 32; do not compare the losses as identical procedures.
Calibration is part of this same training trajectory. Continuation resumes at update 1000 with its optimizer/RNG/curve state.
Time budget is checked at safe update boundaries and can overrun during atomic saves/finalization. GPU job runs on local hardware, not AWS.
500k updates at the calibration target-token rate would sample roughly 437M non-padding targets with replacement; this repeats data and is not a count of unique tokens or complete epochs.
